rate_of_fire_rpm.note: Published cyclic firing rate per gun mount (30x113 mm DEFA)

muzzle_velocity_ms.note: Published nominal muzzle velocity (30x113 mm DEFA)

shed_mass_kg.note: Complete 30x113 mm cartridge mass (~0.42 kg) per gun mount (Mirage 2000 mounts count=2)

explosive_kg.note: Nominal HEI/SAPHEI explosive filler mass per round (30x113 mm DEFA); varies by ammunition mix

dispersion_rad.note: 1-sigma angular dispersion (derived class value from typical 5-8 mil 80% airborne cannon dispersion circle)

drag_cd.note: Reference supersonic form-scaled Cd at Mach 1.8 against BRL/McCoy G7 boattail standard curve (Cd_G7(1.8)=0.298)

capacity.note: Published 125 rounds per DEFA 554 cannon (250 total for dual mount)

self_destruct_s.note: Pyrotechnic self-destruct fuze / effective max flight time for 30x113 mm DEFA (varies by fuze lot)

stanag-4355.title: NATO STANAG 4355 (Modified Point Mass Trajectory Model) & R. L. McCoy, Modern Exterior Ballistics (Schiffer, 1999)
